**Today's Tech News Digest: AI Agents**

The AI agent landscape is maturing rapidly. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises embrace these tools. Meanwhile, model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, signaling a shift toward more autonomous systems. Tool-calling reliability has emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models, while multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demonstrations to regulated enterprise workflows. Finally, observability standards are taking shape, providing frameworks for tracing agent decisions end to end — a crucial step toward accountability and trust in autonomous AI systems.
